While it is true the new controller spec for `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` only checks inheritance and does not cover create/update/destroy, the finding’s broader assertion that these areas have no tests is contradicted by the added model specs and other feature-adjacent specs (e.g., `topic_embed_spec` checking category assignment).
